title: Playing slow melody on Georgia at the Kansas City concert
summary: At the 16-piece Kansas City show he played Georgia and Danny Boy straight with a plunger and the house came down.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: This shows it. In Kansas City, we had musicians, I won't name all of them. We had a bunch (inaudible) and she had all these guys and ________ will tell you the same thing. (Inaudible) opened with 16 pieces (inaudible) with Claude Williams and all of them.
Oh, this was when you went to Kansas City --

Yeah, I programmed a little show for them so they could have something organized, typed it on paper, (inaudible) to do this. We played so and so. We played eight bars of this, make harmony. We were all over with the whole thing and when the ________ closed, they come off, Paul ________ walked through the curtain, and played a number by himself. In the last number, four of us would come up under the curtain and join in. I say that to say this, I followed him. I went out and I played "Georgia"--
What tempo did you play that?
I played "Georgia" (inaudible) because he ended with a fast number. He did three numbers.
But you came and did this slow one.
I did "Georgia" because I didn't want to

do over two numbers. The rest of them could do three, four. I told them, I say, "I'll get as much out of this --" (Laughter.) So I played "Georgia" slow and Buster Smith played the piano, but I had a rhythm section up there and I say, "You don't need to bring anything out on me at all." And I did it with a plunger (inaudible) didn't put one extra note in it. Everything I did was a melody deal. I didn't do any running at all.
I played it and when I got through, the house come down.

They say that's what a melody will do. A chorus and a half, that's all. I played a chorus and I see Gene Ramey take the on the bass -- no, Buster (inaudible) then I came in on the last eight measures and just straight melody and I come out with something heavy, you see the kids jump back.
